working_contract.entrypoint: Unmounted evaluateBusinessEvent library call with a pre-existing release receipt, exact approval/source observation, prior state and one event
working_contract.end_state: Accepted ordered evidence, exact replay, business duplicate, explicit rejection, reconciliation required or exact source-confirmed bounded finality
working_contract.truth_owner: The action's named canonical domain owner; the reducer is not a truth store
working_contract.write_path: None. Durable reducer state, effect reservation, provider execution and canonical mutation are not mounted.

negative_and_recovery_checks: send, order and other-effect one-reservation/one-first-dispatch matrix
exact replay after approval expiry returns the original receipt
second transport delivery of one business event deduplicates to the original receipt
changed-content transport and business identities conflict
future and stale sequence delivery changes no state or counter
expired, future, missing, wrong-record, wrong-owner and wrong-version approval source evidence
approval freshness recheck immediately before first dispatch
post-event source observations cannot retroactively authorize release or first dispatch and change no state or counter
ambiguous network result requires reconciliation and rejects a second dispatch
provider acknowledgement cannot claim business finality
wrong source result version cannot claim business finality
future-dated authoritative readback cannot claim business finality and leaves state, counters and finality unchanged
exact source confirmation recovers ambiguity without a new reservation or dispatch
corrupt reducer state fails before evaluation
C04 capability discovery cannot replace a release receipt or approval
event-type evidence smuggling cannot create acknowledgement or readback finality
